Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform or Bicep for scalable and secure resource provisioning. Implement observability patterns across infrastructure and workloads using tools such as Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights. Collaborate with architecture, security, and operations teams to ensure platforms meet SLAs, DR/RTO requirements, and compliance expectations. Enable GitOps patterns and promote modern deployment practices in collaboration with product engineering teams. Contribute to DevSecOps initiatives and embed security, performance, and resiliency into deployment pipelines. Strong experience with Terraform/Bicep, CI/CD pipelines, and Git-based workflows. Strong background in cloud solution architecture and development of low‑level design documentation Practical understanding of DevOps and SRE practices including automation, observability, and incident response. Experience supporting Power Platform governance (DLP, ALM, monitoring) and citizen development enablement. Skilled in designing secure and scalable AKS workloads and containerized platform services.
